steps.text: Fire needs three things at once — this is the fire triangle. Let's build it and then break it.
Add all three elements: Oxygen, Fuel, and Heat.
With all three present, the fire burns. Now remove one — take away the Oxygen.
The fire goes out. Remove any single side of the triangle — oxygen, fuel, or heat — and combustion stops. That's how we put out fires.

coach.mission: Build the fire triangle, then remove one part to stop the fire.
whenStuck: Add all three: Oxygen, Fuel, and Heat.
Then take one away and watch the fire.
whenWrong: Fire needs all three — oxygen, fuel and heat — together.
Remove any one and the fire can't keep burning.
whenCorrect: Right — all three together make fire.
Good — removing one part put the fire out.
coach.done: You've built and broken the fire triangle. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
